source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE]
            WHERE H = 'D'
			AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8 )AS DATE) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
;


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[SCHM_CODE]
				,CC.[SRL_NUM]
				,CC.[DEL_FLG]
				,CC.[FLOW_CODE]
				,CC.[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,CC.[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,CC.[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,CC.[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,CC.[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[LCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,CC.[RCRE_TIME]
				,CC.[TS_CNT]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE CC
			--JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE B 
			--ON CC.SCHM_CODE = B.SCHM_CODE
			--AND CC.SRL_NUM = B.SRL_NUM
			--AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.SCHM_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SCHM_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SRL_NUM,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SRL_NUM,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1




INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE
(
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 [SCHM_CODE]
				,[SRL_NUM]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[FLOW_CODE]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_MTHS]
				,[FLOW_FREQ_DAYS]
				,[FLOW_PERD_BEG_IND]
				,[FLOW_PERD_END_IND]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'DEP'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_DEP_TDSCHMDEFNTABLE_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
